en.title: User Roles and Account Capabilities
en.excerpt: Detailed breakdown of account roles on Archeris: Organizer, Archer, Seller, and Scorekeeper access permissions.
en.content:
Platform Role Architecture

Archeris uses role-based access control (RBAC) to provide customized interfaces for different stakeholders in the archery community. Each account type has dedicated navigation menus, dashboard widgets, and data management permissions designed specifically for its operational scope.

Tournament Organizer Account

The Organizer account is designed for tournament directors, clubs hosting sanctioned events, and sports event management companies. This role provides full control over the tournament lifecycle:

  • Event Configuration: Create tournaments, define schedules, upload promotional banners, and configure multiple competition divisions.
  • Participant Operations: Review incoming registrations, verify digital payments via QRIS/Virtual Accounts, and manually enroll walk-in archers.
  • Field Allocation: Manage target butt numbers (1A through 1D) with automatic lane allocation algorithms and manual drag-and-drop adjustments.
  • Match Play Execution: Generate World Archery compliant Olympic elimination brackets (1/32 through Finals) and monitor live field scoring.
  • Financial Administration: Manage tournament quota packages, withdraw entry fee revenue, and connect bank accounts for automated disbursements.

Archer Athlete Account

The Archer account is tailored for competitive archers, students, and hobbyists. It acts as a centralized personal sports profile:

  • Event Registration: Sign up for tournaments with one-click profile autofill and instant digital checkout.
  • Live Match Tracking: Check target assignments, scheduled shooting waves, and end-by-end qualification scores directly on mobile devices.
  • Elimination Radar: View real-time match tree progression, upcoming opponents, and scheduled match times.
  • Digital Credentials: Download verified competition certificates featuring tamper-proof QR codes.

Archery Merchant / Seller Account

The Seller account enables archery equipment retailers, bowyers, and archery pro shops to operate a dedicated storefront on the Archeris Marketplace:

  • Product Catalog Management: List bows, arrows, target faces, and tactical archery accessories with detailed technical variations (draw weight, spine, length).
  • Order Fulfillment: Process buyer orders, update shipping statuses, and attach courier tracking waybills.
  • Wallet & Withdrawals: Track pending escrow balances and withdraw sales revenue directly to registered bank accounts.

Temporary Scorekeeper Access

Scorekeepers do not require permanent personal accounts. Instead, organizers generate secure 5-character access codes that allow field scorekeepers to log in instantly via mobile browsers at /scorekeeper/login without entering emails or passwords.

Feature Permission Matrix

The following table summarizes access levels across platform modules:

  • Create & Publish Tournaments: Organizer only (requires active tournament quota).
  • Scorekeeper Field Input: Scorekeepers with valid 5-character event code and Organizer.
  • Register for Competitions: Archer accounts.
  • Sell Equipment on Marketplace: Seller accounts.
  • View Public Leaderboards: Public access (no login required).
  • Download Official Result Books: Public access for completed events.
